summary.text: Caren Lowrey is the Republican candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 132 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Michael Schlossberg.

A certified prevention and education specialist who works with schools across Lehigh County, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running on government accountability, lower costs and education.

paragraphs.text: Caren Lowrey graduated from Parkland High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Delaware in 2000.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a lifelong South Whitehall resident with three children in the Parkland School District, and that she works as a Certified Prevention and Education Specialist partnering with Lehigh County schools on youth substance use, mental health and student well-being.
She also said she serves on the Lehigh County Drug and Alcohol Advisory Board and has experience in a family-owned small business.
Lowrey's survey responses name transparency, fiscal responsibility and on-time budgets, lower everyday costs including reliable and affordable energy, and strengthening schools as her key messages.
She listed education, behavioral health, government accountability and protecting local communities as the policy areas she cares most about.
